title: Italian Style Risotto
description: A classic Italian risotto dish loaded with flavor and texture.
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a large pot.
Cook the risotto according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the pasta and cook until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked risotto to the pasta and stir to combine.
Add the Italian seasoning and mix well.
Transfer the risotto mixture to a serving dish.
Top with Parmesan cheese and serve hot.
Optional: add any additional toppings you like, such as sautéed vegetables or grilled meats.
